name: Input Group
summary: An input with a button or a text affix joined to it: search and submit, password reveal, copy to clipboard. The addon is a real sibling button, never an overlay sitting on top of the value.
demoNote: Zoom to 200% and watch the addon push the field narrower instead of covering the text. The password button changes its name rather than carrying aria-pressed, and the copy confirmation goes to a live region rather than rewriting the button.
